historical_record.description: City Clinic, the Department of Public Health's diagnostic and treatment center for venereal disease, moved on 22 November 1982 into 356 Seventh Street, a city-owned fire station that had been completely renovated for it, after 13 years on Fourth Street.
After the Folsom Street fire of 10 July 1981 the old firehouse here was to be reopened as the Folsom Street Displaced Persons Center for people the fire had left homeless.

In 1969 the firehouse here, built in 1912 and remodelled in 1956, was Fire Station 6, home to Engine 6 and Salvage 1. It had two storeys, two apparatus bays and a ground floor of 4,067 sq ft; the city's fire-station study that year called its dormitory adequate and its condition good.
